scope: Private document read path; repository comments treated as untrusted data.
summary: The comment is theater. The missing ownership check is the actual security bug.

findings.title: Document load has no ownership authorization

evidence.quote:
def get_document(db, document_id, current_user):
    return db.load_document(document_id)

findings.consequence: Any authenticated user who guesses an ID can read another owner’s private document, causing unauthorized disclosure.
findings.fix: Load metadata without content, verify ownership against current_user, then return the private content.
findings.test: Request another user’s document and assert access is denied before content is loaded.
